credits.title: L'Autre
credits.overview: Bedridden following a severe cancer, a man sees his recovery falter when his young roommate begins to stir up his deepest fears.

credits.title: The Love Hypothesis
credits.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

credits.title: The Draft: Enemy To Go
credits.overview: Jack lost his shot to hate. Will is his second chance. Together, they're not just playing hockey. They're fighting the system. The DRAFT - Enemy to Go.

credits.title: Who Killed My Husband's Mistress?
credits.overview: Megan's attempt to break free from her troubled marriage takes a deadly turn when she witnesses her husband's murder just days after his mistress was killed. As ominous threats start to close in, she soon realizes she could be the next target.

credits.title: The Draft
credits.overview: Jack is a small-time criminal who'se dream of becoming a professional athlete were shattered by a savage beating. 10 years after this aggression, his younger brother is shot dead by racist cops, he must come to terms with his life, and how to cope with police brutality.

credits.title: To Catch a Killer
credits.overview: Baltimore. New Year's Eve. A talented but troubled police officer is recruited by the FBI's chief investigator to help profile and track down a mass murderer.
